name: Nepal (19th century)

colors.symbolism: the rhododendron of Nepal and victory in war

description: The double-pennant of Nepal in plain form: two stacked crimson pennants bearing the white moon above and the white sun below, without the later blue border.
history: The traditional double-pennant of the Kingdom of Nepal before the 1962 constitution standardized the modern flag with its blue border; the moon and sun once bore faces, promising the kingdom would last as long as both endure.
